preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to access fee manipulation functions
Contract must have sufficient token balance for swap and liquify mechanism to trigger

violation_target.exploit_hint: 1. As owner, call excludeFromFee(attacker_address) to exempt attacker from transfer fees. 2. Call setTaxFeePercent(), setLiquidityFeePercent(), and setCharityFeePercent() to set maximum allowed fees (total up to 25%). 3. Set _charityAddress to attacker's address to receive charity fees. 4. Trigger transfers from other users to the contract or through the contract. 5. Attacker receives fees from all transfers while paying no fees themselves, effectively draining value from other users' transactions.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The LiquidityGeneratorToken contract has owner-only functions that allow fee manipulation: excludeFromFee(), setTaxFeePercent(), setLiquidityFeePercent(), and setCharityFeePercent(). The contract collects fees on transfers and sends charity fees to _charityAddress. An owner can exclude themselves from fees, set maximum fees (up to 25%), and redirect charity fees to their address. This allows the owner to profit from all other users' transfers without paying fees themselves.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate the contract owner using vm.prank(). 2. Call excludeFromFee(attacker) to exempt attacker from transfer fees. 3. Set all fee percentages to maximum allowed values. 4. Use vm.store() to overwrite _charityAddress storage slot to point to attacker. 5. Create a victim with tokens and trigger a transfer. 6. Attacker receives charity fees from the transfer while paying no fees.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Define interface for owner-only functions. 2. In setUp, inject tokens into contract and attacker using deal(). 3. In testExploit, record initial attacker balance. 4. Prank as owner to call excludeFromFee(attacker). 5. Set tax, liquidity, and charity fees to maximum (total 25%). 6. Use vm.store to overwrite _charityAddress at storage slot 19. 7. Deal tokens to victim address. 8. Have victim transfer tokens to trigger fee collection. 9. Assert attacker balance increased.
